assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the building edit target; Image 2 is the APPROVED MATERIAL AND FINISH REFERENCE. Transform Image 1 to EXACTLY match the strongly GLOSSY lacquered candy-like finish of Image 2. This is a production mobile puzzle-map sprite, viewed small, so gloss MUST be unmistakable even at 150 pixels tall. Preserve the first building's frontal facade, silhouette proportions, straight flat horizontal foundation, architectural identity, doors/windows/emblems and palette. ONLY front elevation, NO perspective side walls or projecting floor. Make all surfaces rounded enameled toy/candy materials with juicy saturated colors, deep rich colored contact shadows and substantial volume. Add LARGE clean white elongated specular highlight patches on every major roof lobe, door, cream wall panel and gold trim, plus secondary broad lighter colored reflection bands, just like Image 2. Cream walls are warm glossy ivory enamel with rounded beveled edges. Golden trims mirror-polished lemon gold, bold white gleams. Glass cyan or amber windows with clean broad reflected white diagonal panels rather than diffuse glowing interiors. Foliage/wreath shiny green sculpted candy leaves. REMOVE any painterly grain, brushwork, mottled plaster, fabric texture, dusty stone, aged wood, matte roughness and tiny busy detailing. Broad smooth high-contrast glossy cartoon, luminous clean white specular shapes, like the HUD's glossy buttons and gold borders. No outer glowing aura, no fog, no sparkles floating outside object, no background, no ground patch or exterior cast shadow, no white sticker contour, no text. Actual transparent background with clean alpha and comfortable margin. Keep the building complete. Keep ruby-red roof, cream facade, green teal door, golden envelope crest, wreath and snow. Simplify many tiny roof tiles into fewer big inflated ruby enamel roof lobes. Snow looks polished pearly icing, not powder.
